features.description: Scheduler: tasks are laid into free gaps around fixed events in priority order; what doesn't fit is overflow; durations never shrink
steps: Given events 10:00-11:00 and tasks 60,60,90 starting 09:00, no task overlaps the event
A task longer than every gap goes to overflow, unchanged
Unit tests in src/core/scheduler.test.ts pass

features.description: Plan today: add tasks (title, category, 15/30/60/90 estimate, priority) and fixed events in the UI and see the timeline plus overflow, persisted across reload
steps: Add 5 tasks and 1 event
Timeline shows blocks in order and an overflow list
Reload: everything still there

features.description: Import a Google Calendar .ics file as today's fixed events
steps: Choose a .ics file with 3 events
Events for today appear in the plan
Malformed file shows an error, data unchanged

features.description: Focus session: Start runs a big countdown for the current block and a stopwatch of real time; Space starts/pauses; survives reload
steps: Press Start: countdown and stopwatch tick
Space pauses
Reload mid-session: timer continues from real elapsed time

features.description: Check-in at block end with Done, +15, +30, Stuck/switch; the rest of today re-flows immediately; keys D and E
steps: When countdown reaches 0 the check-in appears
+15 shifts every later task 15 min and overflow grows
Done logs the session and starts the next block

features.description: Break offer after check-in (5-10 min) that can be skipped; skip is logged
steps: After Done a Break/Skip break choice appears
Skip break is recorded on the session

features.description: Session log + stats page: estimate vs actual by category, focus minutes per day, streak
steps: Complete sessions in two categories
Stats page shows ratio per category and minutes per day
Streak counts consecutive days with a session

features.description: Personal multiplier: with >= 3 sessions in a category, new tasks show a suggested estimate (median ratio) the user can accept or override
steps: Log 3 sessions at ratio 1.5 in 'study'
Adding a 30 min study task suggests 45 (snapped 60 shown as nearest block)
User can keep the original

features.description: Export all data as JSON and sessions as CSV in one click; import CSV time log (date,task,category,estimate_min,actual_min,extended_min,distracted,energy_1to5,note)
steps: Export downloads valid JSON and CSV
Import a CSV with 4 rows adds 4 sessions
Bad rows are reported, good rows imported

features.description: Rewards: optional reward on a task is shown at check-in when the task is done
steps: Add a task with reward '10 min YouTube'
Press Done
Check-in reminds the reward

features.description: Installable PWA that works offline, usable at 375px
steps: Production build registers a service worker and precaches the app
Page loads with network blocked
No horizontal scroll at 375px
